items.text: **The three figures**, recorded after the last edit to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs:1`.

backlog: One connection can subscribe to any number of topics, and the table's bytes are the process's rather than the request's, so `tests/hostile/core/Topic/subscribe/` grows the process by about 20 MB with nothing capping it — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs` module doc § *the table's own bytes are the process's*.

`publish` queues a copy per subscriber against a count bound and no byte bound, so ten-megabyte values stop the program at its memory limit before the queue closes the connection (`tests/hostile/core/Topic/publish/`) — `nvs_runtime::Inbox`'s module doc.
A re-subscribe to a topic already joined allocates three times (`docs/perf/members.ndjson`); `topic_of` copies the name before the lookup — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs`.

The `LogicError` message for a call outside a connection says "connection isolate", which an end user does not know (`docs/examples/core/Topic/subscribe/02-outside-a-connection.out`) — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs` `connection_inbox`.
